questions.q: Which award has been conferred to Ram Chet Chaudhary in the field of Science and Engineering in 2024?
questions.solution:
Ram Chet Chaudhary received the Padma Shri in 2024 for his work in science and engineering, including agricultural research.
**Answer: Padma Shri**

questions.q: The division of labour occurs in:
options: neither unicellular nor in multicelular organism
questions.solution:
Multicellular organisms divide functions among specialised cells and tissues. Unicellular organisms divide functions among cell structures or organelles, so functional division occurs in both.
**Answer: both unicellular and multicellular organisms**

questions.q: Which of the following options represents sub-atomic particles found in Thomson's model of an atom?
questions.solution:
Thomson’s model included negatively charged electrons within a spread-out positive charge. It did not identify separate protons or neutrons within the atom.
**Answer: Only electrons**

questions.q: Which of the following environmental factors plays a role in sex determination of few reptiles?
questions.solution:
Incubation temperature affects sex determination in some reptiles. This is environmental sex determination rather than the human XX/XY mechanism.
**Answer: Temperature**

questions.q: Gastric glands present in the wall of the stomach do NOT release:
questions.solution:
Gastric glands release hydrochloric acid, pepsin-related secretions and mucus. Saliva is produced by salivary glands in the mouth.
**Answer: saliva**

questions.q: Select the correct balanced equation for the reaction Al2(SO4)3 + BaCl2 →→AlCl3 + BaSO4.
questions.solution:
One Al₂(SO₄)₃ needs three BaCl₂, producing two AlCl₃ and three BaSO₄. This balances 2 Al, 3 sulfate groups, 3 Ba and 6 Cl on each side.
**Answer: Al2(SO4)3 + 3BaCl2 → 2AlCl3 + 3 BaSO4**

questions.q: The discussion paper titled '_____' was released by NITI Aayog on 15 January 2024.
questions.solution:
NITI Aayog released Multidimensional Poverty in India since 2005–06 on 15 January 2024. It discussed long-term changes in multidimensional poverty.
**Answer: Multidimensional Poverty in India since 2005-06**

questions.q: When we are travelling in a bus, we tend to move forward when the bus is stopped suddenly. This is because of
questions.solution:
The moving body tends to retain its forward motion when the bus stops suddenly. This is inertia, described by Newton’s first law.
**Answer: the inertia of our body.**

questions.q: Which of the following Sustainable Development Goals is highlighted as needing targeted efforts due to its score being below 50?
questions.solution:
Gender Equality, SDG 5, was the goal identified as requiring targeted improvement because its score remained below 50 in the report referred to.
**Answer: Goal 5 (Gender Equality)**

questions.q: Select the INCORRECT statement.
options: Male gerim-cells are produced by pollen grain.
Female gamete is present in the stigma.
The fusion of male gamete and female gamete is known as fertilisation.
questions.solution:
The female gamete is in the ovule within the ovary. The stigma receives pollen; it does not contain the female gamete, so that pair is incorrect.
**Answer: Female gamete is present in the stigma.**

questions.q: A total of __________ Arjun awards were conferred during the National Sports Awards 2023.
questions.solution:
The National Sports Awards 2023 included 26 Arjuna Award recipients. The presentation ceremony took place in January 2024.
**Answer: 26**

questions.q: In May 2024, DRDO handed over _________ defence technology projects to IIT Bhubaneswar.
questions.solution:
DRDO handed over nine defence-technology projects to IIT Bhubaneswar in May 2024. The projects strengthened the institute’s defence research collaboration.
**Answer: nine**

questions.q: We observe geometrical shadow of an opaque object when light is incident on it. This is due to -·
options: dispersion of the light by an object
light travelling in a straight line
questions.solution:
An opaque object blocks rays travelling along straight paths, producing a geometrical shadow. This illustrates rectilinear propagation of light.
**Answer: light travelling in a straight line**

questions.q: Fruits and seeds have a high concentration of which of the following plant hormones?
questions.solution:
Cytokinins are abundant in actively dividing tissues, including developing fruits and seeds. They promote cell division.
**Answer: Cytokinin**

questions.q: The work done by the motor per unit time is called .
questions.solution:
Power measures work done per unit time. Its SI unit is the watt, equal to one joule per second.
**Answer: power**

questions.q: Which of the following is formed by the action of chlorine on dry slaked lime?
questions.solution:
Chlorine reacting with dry slaked lime produces bleaching powder. It is used for bleaching and disinfection.
**Answer: Bleaching powder**

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an example of homogenous mixture?
questions.solution:
Oil and water separate into layers instead of forming a uniform mixture. The mixture is therefore heterogeneous.
**Answer: Oil in water**

questions.q: When an object is kept at a distance 20 cm in front of a concave mirror, a real image is formed at the centre of curvature of the mirror. Magnification produced by the mirror is
questions.solution:
A real image at the centre of curvature of a concave mirror is formed when the object is also at the centre. It has equal size and is inverted, giving magnification -1.
**Answer: -1**

questions.q: Select the INCORRECT pair.
questions.solution:
Bacteria often act as decomposers and are not fixed to the fourth trophic level. Producers occupy the first level and primary consumers the second.
**Answer: Bacteria - fourth trophic level**

questions.q: Which of the following is the general formula of alkenes?
questions.solution:
An open-chain alkene with one carbon–carbon double bond has formula CₙH₂ₙ. Compared with the corresponding alkane, it has two fewer hydrogen atoms.
**Answer: CnH2n**

questions.q: What will happen during the free fall of a massive object under the influence of gravitational force of the earth?
options: Velocity of the massive object increases.
Velocity of the massive object decreases.
questions.solution:
An object falling towards Earth accelerates under gravity when air resistance is neglected. Its downward velocity therefore increases during the fall.
**Answer: Velocity of the massive object increases.**

questions.q: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
options: The strength of the force of attraction between the particles of matter varies from one kind of matter to another.
The force acting between the particles of matter keeps them together.
The strength of the force of attraction between the particles of matter is constant, irrespective of the kind of matter.
The particles of matter have force acting between them.
questions.solution:
Attractive forces between particles differ among substances and their physical states. They are not constant irrespective of the kind of matter, making the third statement incorrect.
**Answer: The strength of the force of attraction between the particles of matter is constant, irrespective of the kind of matter.**

questions.q: Who among the following is the Non-Playing Captain and Coach of Indian Chess team at Chess Olympiad 2024?
questions.solution:
Srinath Narayanan served as non-playing captain and coach of the Indian team at the 2024 Chess Olympiad. India won the open team gold.
**Answer: Srinath Narayanan**

questions.q: Which of the following electrolytes is used in the electrolytic refining of copper?
questions.solution:
Copper sulphate solution supplies copper ions for electrolytic refining. The impure copper anode dissolves and pure copper deposits at the cathode.
**Answer: Copper sulphate**

questions.q: Which Sikkimese craftsman, renowned for his skill in creating the 'Sumak Thyaktuk' (Lepcha traditional hat), was awarded the Padma Shri in 2024 for his contributions to art and cultural heritage?
questions.solution:
Jordan Lepcha received the Padma Shri in 2024 for his traditional Lepcha craft work, including the Sumak Thyaktuk hat.
**Answer: Jordan Lepcha**

questions.q: Which of the following devices does NOT make use of current carrying conductor in a magnetic field?
questions.solution:
An electric heater primarily works through the heating effect of current in a resistance. Motors and fans rely on magnetic forces; generators use electromagnetic induction.
**Answer: Electric heater**

questions.q: In 2023, which institution implemented two-factor authentication for all e-way bill and e-invoice systems?
questions.solution:
The e-way bill and e-invoice systems are associated with CBIC under the GST administration. The two-factor authentication measure was introduced for those systems.
**Answer: CBIC**

questions.q: Who was appointed as the Director General of the Narcotics Control Bureau on 17 September 2024?
questions.solution:
Anurag Garg was appointed Director General of the Narcotics Control Bureau in September 2024. The question asks for that appointment.
**Answer: Anurag Garg**
